firstMessage.rawMarkdown: Are competitors permitted to use commercially available proprietary LLMs such as OpenAI Codex/GPT or Anthropic Claude during development to generate or label supervised fine-tuning/distillation data for LoRA adapters applied to the required Gemma 4 model? The scored submission itself would contain and run only gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct agents/subagents and competition-permitted adapters; no external LLM or API would be called during inference. If permitted, are there disclosure, accessibility/reasonableness, or redistribution requirements for the generated training data?
